t: This is Thames Street, a busy road in the City of London, the historic and financial centre of the capital. It's split in two: Upper Thames Street to the west and Lower Thames Street to the east, with the London Bridge underpass marking the divide. Together they form part of the A3211 from Tower Hill to Westminster. Joseph Blake was born here in 1700. Known as Blueskin, he was an eighteenth-century highwayman and prison escapee.
